messages:
deploy-bot: [ALERT] Canary failure: rwd-v3.1 deployment to canary pool 'canary-eu-1' reported 12% token errors within 3 minutes. Triggered pager.

jun (oncall): getting paged, on it. reading logs now.

alex (eng-runtime): seeing repeated tokenizer mismatch errors in the canary logs: ``TokenizationError: Unexpected token length for model rwd-v3.1 / tokenizer: byte-pair encoding mismatch``

sara (mlops): also noticed weight checksum mismatch on two GPU boxes in canary: `expected sha256: a1f3... got: b7d2...` Might be a bad weights push.

amanda (prod-eng): customers impacted? any 5xxs in prod traffic?

deploy-bot: traffic split: canary=5% of eu region RA, fallback policy active. No global 5xx spike yet, but latency spikes for canary traces.

ryan (support): we already have two customers reporting garbled completions in eu-east. Ticket #12345, #12346. They see weird tokenization (weird chars).

jun (oncall): ok => escalate. tagging @ops-lead and @alex. I'm going to pause canary traffic to rwd-v3.1.

jun (oncall): running: ``rwctl set-traffic --pool canary-eu-1 --model rwd-v3.1 --percent 0``

deploy-bot: traffic change accepted. Canary pool canary-eu-1 now at 0% for rwd-v3.1. Fallback to rwd-v3.0.

alex (eng-runtime): thanks. I'm pulling the deployment manifests and comparing the artifact references. Preliminary: model artifact path for rwd-v3.1 in the release job pointed to `gs://rwd-models/rwd-v3.1/weights/` but a recent cron may have overwritten symlink to an incompatible quantized set.

sara (mlops): config drift confirmed: tokenizer revision for rwd-v3.1 in prod meta is `tok-v1-bpe` but the weights were produced with `tok-v2-bpe-utf8`. That's the mismatch.

amanda (prod-eng): what's the plan? rollback? kill-switch?

ops-lead: immediate actions: 1) Kill-rollout flag to prevent further auto-promotes. 2) Rollback canary artifacts to known-good. 3) Contact impacted customers. 4) Start full audit of artifact signing.

jun (oncall): enabling kill-switch: ``rwctl feature-flags set model-autoupdate false --scope canary-eu-1``

deploy-bot: feature flag updated: model-autoupdate = false for canary-eu-1

alex (eng-runtime): initiating rollback to rwd-v3.0 stable across canary nodes. Command: ``rwctl rollback --model rwd-v3.0 --target canary-eu-1 --reason "tokenizer/weights mismatch"``

deploy-bot: rollback job queued -> job-id 98765. Estimated completion 2m.

jun (oncall): notifying SRE and support to triage customer tickets. Ryan pls update #12345/12346 that we've paused the canary and rolled back; escalation to engineering.

ryan (support): on it. sending template: "We're aware of garbled completions in EU, paused canary, rolling back, ETA 5m, will follow up." :email:

ops-lead: assign a follow-up postmortem owner. @alex, please own artifact signing and release job checks. @sara own tokenizer compatibility tests in CI.

alex (eng-runtime): will own. I'll add pre-deploy checksum + tokenizer-diff step to release pipeline.

sara (mlops): will add tokenizer compatibility test matrix and artifact signature validation.

amanda (prod-eng): timeline: rollback completed. Can we confirm customer impact cleared?

deploy-bot: rollback job 98765 finished. Canary nodes running rwd-v3.0. No new canary 5xxs. Token error rate dropped to baseline.

jun (oncall): monitoring customer tickets. Ryan any new messages?

ryan (support): customers acknowledged -- #12345 says behavior back to normal, #12346 still validating but no new errors.

ops-lead: severity de-escalation: moving from P1 -> P2. We'll open a formal incident and postmortem doc. Include: root cause = release pipeline allowed unverified weights + tokenizer mismatch; contributing = symlink overwrite from automated artifact job.

alex (eng-runtime): initial remediation completed. Next steps: block auto-overwrite of model symlinks, require signed manifests, add canary-only tokenizer validation job.

amanda (prod-eng): also reach out to Sales/CS for customers who saw problems. Ryan add contact list and summary.

jun (oncall): handoff: @alex will take next 24h on-call follow-up for any regressions, I'll mark incident as active->monitoring.

incident-bot: Incident created INC-2026-045: "Canary encoding/tokenizer mismatch during rwd-v3.1 rollout" assigned to @alex, severity P2.

alex (eng-runtime): logging action items into the incident doc. I'll include logs, shas, and mitigation commands used.

amanda (prod-eng): great job team. any lingering concerns?

sara (mlops): will schedule a retro with release and CI owners. also propose adding end-to-end sampling of canary outputs for 1 hour post-deploy.

ops-lead: thanks everyone. I'll draft a short customer update and a checklist for safe model upgrades.

jun (oncall): closing thread for active mitigation. will reopen if any spike. :white_check_mark:
